title: Dependent Reset
summary: When a parent field changes, clears only the dependent values it made invalid and names each one with Undo, so fields don't vanish silently.
description: A hook clears only what a parent change made invalid (pruning just the add-ons a new plan lacks), and a notice names each lost value, highlights those fields and offers Undo.
catches: Dependent values that became invalid after a parent change
Partial loss (some options pruned) versus a field cleared entirely
Silent data loss, by naming each value and offering Undo
limits: You define which values are valid for each parent value
Undo restores the previous values in the form; it doesn't undo anything already saved
a11y: The notice is role="status" with aria-live="polite"
Each lost field is described in text (e.g. "cleared" or "removed")
